     1	# Get the exercise name from the current directory
     2	get_filename_component(exercise ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} NAME)

     5	cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5.1)

     7	# Name the project after the exercise

    10	# Locate Boost date_time library
    11	set(Boost_USE_MULTITHREADED ON)
    12	set(Boost_USE_STATIC_RUNTIME OFF)
    13	find_package(Boost 1.58 REQUIRED COMPONENTS date_time)
    14	
    15	# Get a source filename from the exercise name by replacing -'s with _'s
    16	string(REPLACE "-" "_" file ${exercise})
    17	
    18	# Implementation could be only a header
    19	if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${file}.cpp)
    20	    set(exercise_cpp ${file}.cpp)

    23	endif()
    24	
    25	# Use the common Catch library?
    26	if(EXERCISM_COMMON_CATCH)
    27	    # For Exercism track development only
    28	    add_executable(${exercise} ${file}_test.cpp ${exercise_cpp} ${file}.h $<TARGET_OBJECTS:catchlib>)
    29	elseif(EXERCISM_TEST_SUITE)
    30	    # The Exercism test suite is being run, the Docker image already
    31	    # includes a pre-built version of Catch.
    32	    find_package(Catch2 REQUIRED)
    33	    add_executable(${exercise} ${file}_test.cpp ${exercise_cpp} ${file}.h)

    35	    # When Catch is installed system wide we need to include a different
    36	    # header, we need this define to use the correct one.
    37	    target_compile_definitions(${exercise} PRIVATE EXERCISM_TEST_SUITE)
    38	else()

    40	    add_executable(${exercise} ${file}_test.cpp ${exercise_cpp} ${file}.h test/tests-main.cpp)
    41	endif()
    42

    44	    CXX_STANDARD 17
    45	    CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED OFF
    46	    CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF
    47	)

    49	set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug)
    50

    52	    set_target_properties(${exercise} PROPERTIES
    53	        COMPILE_FLAGS "-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror"
    54	    )
    55	endif()
    56	
    57	# We need boost libraries
    58	target_link_libraries(${exercise}
    59	    PRIVATE
    60	    Boost::date_time
    61	)
    62	
    63	# Configure to run all the tests?
    64	if(${EXERCISM_RUN_ALL_TESTS})
    65	    target_compile_definitions(${exercise} PRIVATE EXERCISM_RUN_ALL_TESTS)
    66	endif()
    67	
    68	# Tell MSVC not to warn us about unchecked iterators in debug builds
    69	# Treat warnings as errors

    71	if(${MSVC})
    72	    set_target_properties(${exercise} PROPERTIES
    73	        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS_DEBUG _SCL_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
    74	        COMPILE_FLAGS "/WX /w44244 /w44267")
    75	endif()
